title: New Mexico Statutes Annotated 1978, Chapter 50 (Employment Law), Article 4 - Labor Conditions; Payment of Wages (contains the Minimum Wage Act)
verified_how: Fetched the NM OneSource chapter page (item 4420, '?iframe=true' form) in a browser on 23 September 2026: page title 'Chapter 50 - Employment Law - NMOneSource.com'; the item's metadata field reads Collection 'Current New Mexico Statutes Annotated 1978' and the breadcrumb for the collection reads 'Current New Mexico Statutes Annotated 1978 > Date: 2026'; the chapter table of contents lists 'ARTICLE 4 Labor Conditions; Payment of Wages' with no repeal marker, where other articles in the same chapter are expressly marked '(Repealed.)' (e.g. 'ARTICLE 5 Employment of Women (Repealed.)', 'ARTICLE 14A Rapid Workforce Development (Repealed.)'). Currency confirmed separately from the Commission's own site (www.nmcompcomm.us/scope-of-coverage-2/): NMSA 1978 on NM OneSource is current through the Second Session of the Fifty-Seventh Legislature (2026); NM OneSource footer shows 'Website last modified: 09/22/2026'.
notes: Article 4 carries both the wage-payment rules (pay periods, permitted deductions, enforcement by the Labor Relations Division of the Workforce Solutions Department) and the Minimum Wage Act, the short-titled Act within the article. The article-level citation is the form the register itself uses; individual section numbers were not each verified.
